categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文从分词复杂度理论、推理路径多样性到多用户语音评测，焦点在模型能力边界与评测可信度。

articles.title: Spectrum Adaptation of AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
articles.zh: 基于迁移学习的 AI 原生自编码器通信频谱适配
articles.summary: 如果你在研究 AI 原生空口或语义通信，这篇讲的是换频段后怎么靠迁移学习省掉重新训练的成本
articles.author: Yalin E. Sagduyu, Tugba Erpek
articles.body: End-to-end physical-layer learning replaces separate modulation, coding, and detection operations with an autoencoder (AE) that consists of a jointly trained encoder-decoder pair at the transmitter and the receiver. This paper studies AI-native communications with AEs and quantifies the sensitivity to training-test mismatch in channel models. Models trained only on an AWGN channel achieve low bit error rates (BERs) under matched conditions but degrade severely on Rayleigh fading with practical front-end impairments. To reduce the time and energy required to adapt to new channel conditions, we propose a low-latency transfer-learning procedure that starts from an AWGN-pretrained system and fine-tunes only a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers while freezing the remainder. We further formulate layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem that identifies the most informative parameters to update during adaptation. This preserves the learned signal geometry and the deep decision structure while adapting lightweight front ends to fading- and impairment-induced mixing. For AE communications, we show that partial updates remove the mismatch-induced error floor and approach the BER of fully retrained models. We provide a layer-wise study and quantify resource-performance trade-offs, showing that modest adaptation substantially reduces BER while cutting training time, multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations, energy consumption, and the fraction of updated parameters for resource-efficient implementation.
articles.bodyZh: 端到端物理层学习（end-to-end physical-layer learning）不再把调制、编码和检测拆开做，而是用一个自编码器（autoencoder, AE）来代替：发射端和接收端各有一部分，编码器和解码器一起训练。这篇文章研究用自编码器做AI原生通信（AI-native communications），并量化它对信道模型里“训练和测试不匹配”有多敏感。只在AWGN信道（加性高斯白噪声信道）上训练出来的模型，在条件匹配时误码率（BER）很低，但一放到有实际前端损伤的瑞利衰落（Rayleigh fading）环境里，性能就会明显掉下来。为了减少适应新信道条件所需的时间和能量，我们提出一种低时延迁移学习（transfer-learning）流程：从AWGN预训练系统出发，只微调发射端和接收端的一小部分层，其余层冻结不动。我们还把“选哪些层来更新”建模成一个预算受限的优化问题（budget-constrained optimization problem），用它找出适应过程中最值得更新的参数。这样既能保留学到的信号几何结构（signal geometry）和深层判决结构（deep decision structure），又能让轻量前端适应衰落和损伤带来的信号混叠。针对AE通信，我们证明部分更新可以消除不匹配导致的误码率底噪（error floor），并接近完全重训练模型的BER。我们还做了逐层研究（layer-wise study），量化资源与性能之间的取舍，结果表明：适度适应就能大幅降低BER，同时减少训练时间、乘加运算量（MAC operations）、能耗以及被更新参数的比例，从而更省资源地落地。

articles.title: Tokenisation is not in APX
articles.zh: Tokenisation 问题不属于 APX 复杂度类
articles.summary: 如果你以为最优分词有常数因子近似算法可用，这篇从计算复杂度上直接证否，别把工程启发式当成理论保证
articles.author: Violeta Kastreva, Philip Whittington 等
articles.body: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.
articles.bodyZh: 在这篇论文里，我们证明：除非 P=NP，否则没有任何多项式时间算法能找到一个分词器（tokeniser），让它的目标函数值落在最优解的任意常数倍范围内。换句话说，分词问题不在 APX 复杂度类里。我们针对直接分词（direct tokenisation）和自底向上分词（bottom-up tokenisation）都证明了这一点；不管目标是压缩目标还是一元对数似然目标（unigram log-likelihood），也不管字符集是二元还是更大，结论都成立。我们还进一步表明，哪怕字符集只有一种字符（unary alphabet），直接分词也是 APX-hard 的，所以它不存在多项式时间近似方案（polynomial-time approximation scheme）。

articles.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
articles.zh: 图像生成能提升视觉推理吗？一项实证研究
articles.summary: 如果你正打算靠"先生成图再推理"来提升多模态模型表现，这篇先给你泼一盆对照实验的冷水
articles.author: Xueyang Yu, Yifan Jing 等
articles.body: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.
articles.bodyZh: 语言模型（language models）是用文字来“想事情”的；那多模态模型（multimodal models）会不会是用图像来“想事情”呢？我们测了一件事：给模型生成一张“帮手图”，能不能让它把视觉问答（visual question）答得更好。做法是，模型先描述自己需要什么样的辅助图，然后再把原图和生成出来的图放在一起作答。结果在13组“视觉语言模型（vision-language model）+图像生成器”的搭配里，加生成图反而让平均准确率掉了3.7个百分点，十个任务里有九个都下降。两个统一模型（unified models）BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B，各自都在八个任务上准确率下降。在VSTAR上，同样的规划提示（planning hint）再加一张生成图，准确率反而低了10.47个百分点。反复改图，在不同任务上的结果也不一样。ChartQAPro和MathVista一直低于不加生成图的基线（baseline），而ERQA在改图十次之后涨了三个点。

articles.title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
articles.zh: 攻击策略的选择会误导监控评估器
articles.summary: 如果你靠 monitor 打分来防住不可信模型，这篇提醒你攻击方只要挑挑策略，就能把评估器带偏
articles.author: Charlie Griffin, Oliver Makins 等
articles.body: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation applied within that method. This rate ranged from 0.5\% to 20.8\% across optimisation levels of a single method (reinforcement learning), and from 6.4\% to 23.0\% across methods at their best observed optimisation level (optimised prompting vs.\ transcript editing). Every attack policy was developed against proxy monitors only: all reported results show attacks transferring to the held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Our results suggest that monitor evasion evaluations can easily mislead: an evaluation using only basic attack methods may give false confidence that a monitor is strong. The sensitivity to attack-policy choice raises a problem: interpreting any particular result as evidence about deployment performance requires justification. The transcripts produced by attack policies are proxies for the dangerous behaviour a monitor must flag in deployment. These proxies can introduce visible artefacts, such as reasoning about a ``side task'' absent from the instructions shown to the monitor, that affect monitor judgements. Given the sensitivity above, the choice of proxy can change an evaluation's conclusion. Reading these results as evidence about deployment therefore requires a separate legitimacy argument for why the proxies are informative, including any justification of conservativeness. Making convincing arguments remains an open problem.
articles.bodyZh: AI 监控器（AI monitors）——也就是用来标记 AI 智能体（AI agents）危险行为的分类器（classifiers）——评估时，常常拿攻击策略生成的对话记录（transcripts）来测，而这些攻击策略在评估里充当部署中危险行为的替身。我们拿一个曾用于生产环境的 OpenAI 监控器做案例研究，结果发现：测出来的漏报率（false negative rate）对两件事特别敏感——一是用什么方法生成攻击策略，二是这种方法内部优化到什么程度。同一个方法（强化学习，reinforcement learning）只改变优化程度，漏报率就从 0.5% 到 20.8%；换成不同方法、各取观察到的最高优化水平来比（优化提示词，optimised prompting，对比编辑对话记录，transcript editing），漏报率又在 6.4% 到 23.0% 之间。每种攻击策略都只针对代理监控器（proxy monitors）来开发；但我们报告的所有结果都显示，这些攻击能迁移到留出的 GPT-5.4 目标监控器（held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor）上。我们的结果说明，监控器规避评估（monitor evasion evaluations）很容易误导人：如果只用基础攻击方法做评估，可能会让人误以为某个监控器很强。对攻击策略选择这么敏感，就带来一个问题：要把某个具体结果解读成部署表现的证据，得先给出理由。攻击策略生成的对话记录，只是监控器在部署中必须标记出来的危险行为的替身。这些替身会带入一些明显痕迹（artefacts），比如攻击策略在推理一个监控器看到的指令里根本没有的“副任务（side task）”，而这些痕迹会影响监控器的判断。考虑到上面说的这种敏感性，选哪种替身，可能直接改变评估结论。所以，要把这些结果当作部署证据来读，就得单独论证这些替身为什么有信息量，也包括说明它们的保守性（conservativeness）是否合理。而怎么做出有说服力的论证，目前仍是个没解决的问题。

articles.title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
articles.zh: 面向困难数学问题的多样化替代推理路径
articles.summary: 如果你在训数学推理模型，只盯一条标准解法会限制模型，这篇讲怎么造出多样且正确的替代解法
articles.author: Lukas Aichberger, Adam Golinski 等
articles.body: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.
articles.bodyZh: 给大型语言模型（LLMs）做数学推理的后训练时，常见做法是拿那些最终答案能通过验证器的推理轨迹来训练。但碰到难题时，靠独立的蒙特卡洛（MC）采样，这种能通过验证的轨迹往往很少见。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“多样化替代推理轨迹”（DART）：它是一种轨迹挖掘方法，先从一个被拒绝的轨迹出发，把它拆成一步步推理，再按“位置加权不确定性”给这些步骤排序；然后针对排在前面的步骤，借助参考答案引导和一段“元思考”，专门生成明显不同的替代候选，最后把整条轨迹补完。在贪心解码解不出来的 DeepMath-103K 题目上，在生成轨迹数量相同的情况下，DART 比 MC 采样多找回了 37% 的题目；它每找回一道题的估计生成成本几乎一样，但每条被接受轨迹的成本低 30%。用 DART 挖出来的轨迹对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 做后训练后，在 MATH-500 和 AIME 基准的六项评估中，有五项取得了最高的点估计。这些结果表明，用 DART 重新审视那些被拒绝的轨迹，既能扩大题目覆盖范围，也能提供有效的后训练数据。

articles.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
articles.summary: 如果你在琢磨怎么在固定参数下多堆"思考"算力，这种给 Transformer 加深循环深度的思路值得一看
articles.author: Lianghui Zhu, Shijie Wang 等
articles.body: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT
articles.bodyZh: 循环Transformer（Looped Transformers）靠跨循环复用共享层来提升表达能力，但代价是效率。想把它们的“表达能力—效率”边界再往前推，就得重新想相邻循环之间靠什么核心机制衔接：一个Transformer在循环之间到底该传什么？我们提出Mixture-of-Loops Transformer（MoLT），它的Mixture-of-Loops Attention（MoLA）把键和值（keys and values，KV）当成记忆，在不同深度和循环之间做选择性复用。在“循环残差”（loop residual）方案下，MoLT-R保留残差流（residual stream），并跨循环读取局部KV，以此换取表达能力。在“循环KV”（loop KV）方案下，MoLT-KV改成从嵌入（embeddings）重新开始，读取当前循环的局部KV，并在更早位置读取上一循环的记忆KV，以此提升效率。MoLT-KV去掉了同一位置上的跨循环依赖，再配合用于并行训练的“循环强制”（loop forcing），就能解锁单次遍历的Mixture-of-Loops（MoL）解码，而且能超出训练时的循环范围。为了平衡效率和质量，我们提出U形MoLT（U-MoLT），把记忆构建和预测读出分开，并且在不改变预测结果的前提下，跳过没用到的解码器遍历（decoder traversals）。在400B token的预训练（pretraining）里，U-MoLT在700M/1.5B稠密模型和3B混合专家（MoE）模型上都超过了OLMo3：在700M规模上，验证集交叉熵（CE）的token效率达到1.7倍；同时把3B MoE在10个领域上的困惑度（perplexity）改善了0.75，在10个任务上的准确率提高了2.1个百分点。在对Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base做100B token的继续预训练（continued pretraining）时，我们把U-MoLT适配上去，结果在全部11个领域上都比匹配的基线（baseline）降低了CE，平均token效率达到1.4倍。推理（inference）时，带MoL-Hybrid-2的U-MoLT在S规模（约113M）模型上的延迟（latency）和非循环版OLMo3打平，分别是996.6毫秒对1000.6毫秒。代码在 https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

articles.title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
articles.zh: μ-Bench：共享交互场景下语音 Agent 多用户任务完成能力基准
articles.summary: 如果你在做语音助手却只测单人对话，这个 benchmark 会让你看到多人同时开口时任务完成有多难
articles.author: Qihao Lin, Guanxu Chen 等
articles.body: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.
articles.bodyZh: 共享空间里的语音智能体（voice agents）得同时满足多个用户互相牵连的需求，还要守住每个用户各自的权限、隐私和任务约束。现有评测在“参与者会在整段会话里随时做出反应”这种情况下，覆盖还不够。我们推出 μ-Bench，一个用来评测闭环（closed-loop）、全双工（full-duplex）多用户语音交互中联合任务完成情况的基准（benchmark）。模拟参与者各自基于隔离的目标、知识和权限档案（profiles）行动，并会根据智能体的说话内容和工具结果实时调整。覆盖20个领域、100个场景，通过改变群体规模、声学环境和后续追问要求，组成800个案例（408个带工具 tool-augmented，392个不带工具 tool-free）。联合任务成功（Joint Task Success, JTS）要求所有用户目标、隐私边界和最终状态同时成立；纯JTS（Pure JTS）还额外不允许未经授权的工具调用（unauthorized tool calls）；归因、线程化和协调（Attribution, Threading, and Coordination, ATC）诊断则用来定位失败出在哪。在13个语音智能体里，闭源商业系统（proprietary systems）最高做到无工具62.24%、带工具65.44%的成功率，而开放权重模型（open-weight models）还不到20%。ATC诊断显示，开放权重模型主要差在多轮归因（multi-turn attribution）和线程化（threading）上；控制变量对比（controlled contrasts）还发现，只要群体规模变大，能力较强的系统在联合任务成功率上也会稳定下降。通过把能实时反应的多用户模拟（reactive multi-user simulation）和可验证的会话级结果（verifiable session-level outcomes）结合起来，μ-Bench 为共享空间里的语音智能体提供了一个严格的测试平台（testbed）。

articles.title: Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness using Latent Space Representations
articles.zh: 利用潜空间表示增强海上态势感知
articles.summary: 如果你在建模 AIS 等海事数据，用潜空间表示替代原始轨迹特征，这篇给了个可参考的路子
articles.author: Rikard Vinge, Miguel A. Belenguer-Plomer 等
articles.body: This work presents a novel application of Earth Observation (EO) embeddings for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) from the perspective of the geospatial foundation model TerraMind. By operating directly on compressed latent-space representations rather than on the original Sentinel-1 imagery, this approach directly addresses the data gravity bottleneck that increasingly constrains operational EO processing, in line with the objectives of the Embed2Scale project. In particular, linear and non-linear probing of compressed embeddings, latent space representations of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, is used to detect, localise, and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 GRD images. Vessel detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.95, while vessel localisation has a median error of around 300 m for vessels longer than 100 m, and vessel AIS type-code classification achieves 62% accuracy for the majority classes. The latter, however, is highly correlated with vessel length. These results reveal both the potential and current limitations of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) when applied to fine-grained MDA understanding in real-world scenarios. Additionally, a new maritime remote sensing dataset is released, pairing about 2,000 Sentinel-1 images with temporally aligned AIS signals from commercial vessels. Through manual inspection, each candidate sample was verified for bounding-box quality and for consistency between the AIS-reported vessel length and the observed vessel extent, cross-checking vessel identity and location against publicly available vessel records and, where available, photographs. The dataset was made ready for use with the NeuCo-Bench neural compression benchmark framework, publicly available on HuggingFace through https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship-downstream .
articles.bodyZh: 这项工作从地理空间基础模型 TerraMind 的视角出发，展示了把地球观测（Earth Observation, EO）嵌入向量用于海上态势感知（Maritime Domain Awareness, MDA）的一个新应用。它不直接处理原始的 Sentinel-1 影像，而是在压缩后的潜空间表示上直接运算，这就正面应对了越来越限制业务化地球观测处理流程的“数据重力”瓶颈（data gravity bottleneck），也符合 Embed2Scale 项目的目标。具体来说，作者用线性探针和非线性探针（linear and non-linear probing）去测试压缩后的嵌入，也就是合成孔径雷达（synthetic aperture radar, SAR）影像在潜空间里的表示，从 Sentinel-1 GRD 影像中检测、定位并刻画船只。船只检测的 ROC-AUC 达到 0.95；对于长度超过 100 米的船，定位误差中位数大约为 300 米；船只 AIS 类型码分类在主要类别上达到 62% 的准确率。不过，后一项和船的长度高度相关。这些结果既说明地理空间基础模型（Geospatial Foundation Models, GeoFMs）在真实场景里做细粒度海上态势理解有潜力，也暴露了目前的局限。另外，作者还发布了一个新的海上遥感数据集，把大约 2,000 张 Sentinel-1 影像和来自商船、在时间上对齐的 AIS 信号配对起来。每个候选样本都经过人工检查，核对了边界框质量，以及 AIS 报告的船长和实际观测到的船体范围是否一致；还用公开的船只记录，以及在有照片时用照片，交叉核对船只身份和位置。这个数据集已经整理好，可直接配合 NeuCo-Bench 神经压缩基准框架（neural compression benchmark framework）使用，并在 HuggingFace 上公开：https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship-downstream 。
